--[[
    ASTA | Auto Safe
    مفتاح -> اختيار الاوتو (80 / 90 / 100) -> تشغيل
    80%  : يلزق بالخصم
    90%  : يثبت على مسافة 2 من الخصم
    100% : يثبت على مسافة 3 من الخصم
]]

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService     = game:GetService("TweenService")
local lp               = Players.LocalPlayer

local KEY = "HHH44"

local C = {
    bg     = Color3.fromRGB(3, 7, 22),
    card   = Color3.fromRGB(9, 22, 62),
    cardHi = Color3.fromRGB(14, 42, 120),
    accent = Color3.fromRGB(30, 120, 255),
    accent2= Color3.fromRGB(100, 180, 255),
    text   = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255),
    sub    = Color3.fromRGB(110, 165, 255),
    line   = Color3.fromRGB(25, 85, 210),
    bad    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
    good   = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 170),
}

-- صور الخيارات (مدمجة داخل السكربت). تقدر تبدلها برابط/رقم أصل في IMAGES
-- [1] = امان 80 | [2] = امان 90 | [3] = امان 100
local IMAGES = {
    [1] = "",
    [2] = "",
    [3] = "",
}
local EMBED = {
    [1] = [==[]==],
    [2] = [==[]==],
    [3] = [==[]==],
}

local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local B64MAP = {}
for i = 1, #B64 do B64MAP[string.sub(B64, i, i)] = i - 1 end
local function b64decode(data)
    data = string.gsub(data, "[^%w%+/]", "")
    local out, buf, bits, n = {}, 0, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #data do
        buf = buf * 64 + B64MAP[string.sub(data, i, i)]
        bits = bits + 6
        if bits >= 8 then
            bits = bits - 8
            local p2 = 2 ^ bits
            n = n + 1
            out[n] = string.char(math.floor(buf / p2) % 256)
            buf = buf % p2
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local assetCache, assetWaiters = {}, {}
local function withImage(idx, cb)
    if assetCache[idx] then cb(assetCache[idx]) return end
    if assetWaiters[idx] then table.insert(assetWaiters[idx], cb) return end
    assetWaiters[idx] = {cb}
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, asset = pcall(function()
            local src = IMAGES[idx]
            if src and src ~= "" then
                if not string.find(src, "^https?://") then return src end
                local fname = "asta_bg_" .. idx .. ".png"
                writefile(fname, game:HttpGet(src))
                return getcustomasset(fname)
            end
            local fname = "asta_bg_" .. idx .. ".jpg"
            writefile(fname, b64decode(EMBED[idx]))
            return getcustomasset(fname)
        end)
        if ok and asset then
            assetCache[idx] = asset
            for _, f in ipairs(assetWaiters[idx]) do pcall(f, asset) end
        end
    end)
end

-- المسافة بالـ studs (مقاس روبلوكس) بين مركز شخصيتك ومركز الخصم
local MODES = {
    {name = "اوتو: امان 80%",  tag = "يلزق بالخصم", dist = 0, idx = 1},
    {name = "اوتو: امان 90%",  tag = "مسافة 2",     dist = 2, idx = 2},
    {name = "اوتو: امان 100%", tag = "مسافة 3",     dist = 3, idx = 3},
}

-- ============ أدوات ============
local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do o[k] = v end
    if parent then o.Parent = parent end
    return o
end
local function corner(o, r) return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 10)}, o) end
local function stroke(o, col, th, tr)
    return new("UIStroke", {Color = col, Thickness = th or 1, Transparency = tr or 0,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o)
end
local function gradient(o, c1, c2, rot)
    return new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Rotation = rot or 90}, o)
end

-- حذف النسخة القديمة
do
    local places = {}
    pcall(function() table.insert(places, gethui and gethui() or nil) end)
    pcall(function() table.insert(places, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
    pcall(function() table.insert(places, lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) end)
    for _, p in ipairs(places) do
        local old = p and p:FindFirstChild("AstaAuto")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end
end

local gui = new("ScreenGui", {Name = "AstaAuto", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
    ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, DisplayOrder = 999})
do
    local ok = pcall(function() gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    if not ok or not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
end

-- ============ حالة ============
local running = false
local current = nil      -- المود المختار
local closed = false
local conns = {}

local function makePanel(w, h)
    local p = new("Frame", {
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, h), BackgroundColor3 = C.bg,
    }, gui)
    new("UISizeConstraint", {MinSize = Vector2.new(300, h), MaxSize = Vector2.new(w, h)}, p)
    corner(p, 22); stroke(p, C.accent, 2, 0.15)
    gradient(p, Color3.fromRGB(8, 20, 60), C.bg, 90)
    return p
end

local function bigButton(parent, text, pos, size)
    local b = new("TextButton", {
        Text = text, AutoButtonColor = false, Position = pos, Size = size,
        BackgroundColor3 = C.cardHi, TextColor3 = C.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 18,
    }, parent)
    corner(b, 14); stroke(b, C.accent2, 1.5, 0.3)
    gradient(b, Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 230), Color3.fromRGB(10, 40, 130), 90)
    return b
end

-- ============ منطق الاوتو ============
local function getChar(p)
    local c = p and p.Character
    if not c then return nil end
    local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if h and r and h.Health > 0 then return c, h, r end
    return nil
end

local function nearestTarget(myRoot)
    local best, bd = nil, math.huge
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lp then
            local _, _, r = getChar(p)
            if r then
                local d = (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bd then best, bd = r, d end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- كشف تحكم اللاعب (عصا الجوال / الكيبورد): إذا تمشي بنفسك الاوتو ما يتدخل
local controls = nil
task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local ps = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 5)
        local pm = ps and ps:WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 5)
        if pm then controls = require(pm):GetControls() end
    end)
end)
local function userIsMoving()
    if controls then
        local ok, v = pcall(function() return controls:GetMoveVector() end)
        if ok and v then return v.Magnitude > 0.1 end
    end
    local k = Enum.KeyCode
    return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(k.W) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(k.A)
        or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(k.S) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(k.D)
end

-- كشف القنبلة: الاوتو ما يروح للخصم إلا لما تكون القنبلة عندك
local function nameLooksBomb(n)
    n = string.lower(n)
    return string.find(n, "bomb", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(n, "tnt", 1, true) ~= nil
        or string.find(n, "dynamite", 1, true) ~= nil
end
local function hasBomb(p)
    local c = p.Character
    if not c then return false end
    for _, item in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Tool") then return true end
    end
    for _, n in ipairs({"HasBomb", "Bomb", "IsBomb", "BombHolder", "Holding", "IsIt", "It", "hasBomb"}) do
        if c:GetAttribute(n) == true or p:GetAttribute(n) == true then return true end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        if nameLooksBomb(d.Name) then
            if d:IsA("BoolValue") then
                if d.Value then return true end
            elseif d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("Tool") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local holding, lastScan = false, 0

table.insert(conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if closed or not running or not current then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastScan > 0.12 then
        lastScan = now
        holding = hasBomb(lp)
    end
    if not holding then return end
    local c, h, r = getChar(lp)
    if not c then return end
    if userIsMoving() then return end

    local tr = nearestTarget(r)
    if not tr then return end

    local diff = Vector3.new(tr.Position.X - r.Position.X, 0, tr.Position.Z - r.Position.Z)
    local dist = diff.Magnitude
    local want = current.dist

    if want <= 0 then
        -- 80%: يلزق بالخصم
        h:MoveTo(tr.Position)
    elseif dist < 0.05 then
        return
    elseif dist > want + 0.5 then
        -- بعيد: قرّب لين توصل المسافة
        h:MoveTo(tr.Position - diff.Unit * want)
    elseif dist < want - 0.5 then
        -- قريب زيادة: ابعد شوي
        h:MoveTo(r.Position - diff.Unit * 3)
    else
        h:MoveTo(r.Position)   -- على المسافة المطلوبة: ثبّت
    end
end))

-- ============ زر التشغيل (يتحرك) ============
local showSelect -- تعريف مسبق

local WIDGET_SCALE = 0.7

local function showToggle()
    local locked = false
    local frame = new("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -190, 0, 70), Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 104),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 10, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
        Active = true, ZIndex = 20,
    }, gui)
    corner(frame, 6)
    new("UIScale", {Scale = WIDGET_SCALE}, frame)   -- حجم الواجهة (صغّر الرقم لتصغيرها)
    gradient(frame, Color3.fromRGB(12, 28, 78), Color3.fromRGB(3, 6, 20), 120)
    local rim = stroke(frame, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 3, 0)
    local rimGrad = new("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, C.accent2), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(150, 90, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C.accent2)}), Rotation = 0}, rim)

    -- خلفية الواجهة كلها (صورة الخيار) + تظليل
    local bgImg = new("ImageLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Image = "", ZIndex = 19}, frame)
    corner(bgImg, 6)
    local bgShade = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 19}, frame)
    corner(bgShade, 6)
    withImage(current.idx, function(asset) if bgImg and bgImg.Parent then bgImg.Image = asset end end)

    -- منطقة الضغط (تشغيل/إيقاف): الصورة + الاسم + الحالة
    local tog = new("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 252, 1, 0), ZIndex = 21}, frame)

    new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 28),
        Text = current.name, TextColor3 = C.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 18,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 22}, tog)
    local pillBg = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 52), Size = UDim2.new(0, 104, 0, 38),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 15, 20), ZIndex = 22}, tog)
    corner(pillBg, 6)
    local dot = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, -12),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.bad, ZIndex = 23}, pillBg)
    corner(dot, 4)
    local stateLbl = new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 1, 0), Text = "OFF", TextColor3 = C.bad, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
        TextSize = 20, ZIndex = 23}, pillBg)

    -- أزرار: قفل (أيقونة) / تغيير / X
    local function small(text, x, y, w, col)
        local b = new("TextButton", {Text = text, AutoButtonColor = false, Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = col or C.card, TextColor3 = C.accent2,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14, ZIndex = 21}, frame)
        corner(b, 6)
        return b
    end
    local lockBtn = small("", 262, 12, 106, C.card)
    local change  = small("تغيير", 262, 54, 68, C.card)
    local stop    = small("X", 336, 54, 32, C.bad)
    stop.TextColor3 = C.text; stop.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack; stop.TextSize = 16

    -- أيقونة القفل مرسومة (جسم + حلقة + ثقب المفتاح)
    local holder = new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 4), Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 28), ZIndex = 22, Active = false}, lockBtn)
    local shackle = new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 18), ZIndex = 22}, holder)
    corner(shackle, 6)
    local shStroke = stroke(shackle, Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), 3, 0)
    local body = new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 12), Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 16),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), ZIndex = 23}, holder)
    corner(body, 3)
    local keyhole = new("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 7), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 14, 40), ZIndex = 24}, body)
    corner(keyhole, 3)

    local function render()
        local col = running and C.good or C.bad
        stateLbl.Text = running and "ON" or "OFF"
        stateLbl.TextColor3 = col
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = col
        dot.Position = running and UDim2.new(1, -31, 0.5, -12) or UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, -12)
        pillBg.BackgroundColor3 = running and Color3.fromRGB(10, 55, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 15, 20)
    end
    local function renderLock()
        local yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40)
        shStroke.Color = yellow
        body.BackgroundColor3 = yellow
        lockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = locked and Color3.fromRGB(70, 52, 6) or C.card
        -- مقفل: الحلقة مسكرة / مفتوح: الحلقة مرفوعة ومايلة
        shackle.Position = locked and UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, -5)
        shackle.Rotation = locked and 0 or 28
    end
    render(); renderLock()

    -- توهج الإطار يتحرك لما يكون ON
    table.insert(conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if running and frame.Parent then rimGrad.Rotation = (os.clock() * 120) % 360 end
    end))

    lockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        locked = not locked
        renderLock()
    end)

    -- سحب + نقرة (النقرة تشغل/تطفي، السحب يحرك الواجهة إذا مو مقفلة)
    local pressed, moved, onTog, dragStart, startPos = false, false, false, nil, nil
    local function begin(i, fromTog)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            pressed, moved, onTog, dragStart, startPos = true, false, fromTog, i.Position, frame.Position
        end
    end
    tog.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) begin(i, true) end)
    frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if not pressed then begin(i, false) end end)
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if pressed and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            local d = i.Position - dragStart
            if d.Magnitude > 8 then moved = true end
            if moved and not locked then
                frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            if pressed and onTog and not moved then
                running = not running
                render()
            end
            pressed = false
        end
    end))

    change.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        running = false
        frame:Destroy()
        showSelect()
    end)
    stop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        closed = true; running = false
        for _, cn in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() cn:Disconnect() end) end
        gui:Destroy()
    end)
end

-- ============ اختيار الاوتو ============
function showSelect()
    local p = makePanel(560, 270)
    new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46),
        Text = "سكربتات الاوتو", TextColor3 = C.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 19}, p)
    new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 46), Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 2),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.line, BorderSizePixel = 0}, p)

    local picked = nil
    local cards = {}
    for i, m in ipairs(MODES) do
        -- الترتيب من اليمين لليسار مثل الصورة: 100 ثم 90 ثم 80
        local slot = #MODES - i
        local card = new("TextButton", {
            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ClipsDescendants = true,
            Position = UDim2.new(0.04 + slot * 0.32, 0, 0, 62), Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 118),
            BackgroundColor3 = C.card,
        }, p)
        corner(card, 12)
        local st = stroke(card, C.line, 1.5, 0.4)
        gradient(card, Color3.fromRGB(30, 100, 230), Color3.fromRGB(10, 25, 80), 60)
        -- صورة الخلفية (أنمي)
        local img = new("ImageLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Image = "", ZIndex = 1}, card)
        corner(img, 12)
        withImage(i, function(asset) if img and img.Parent then img.Image = asset end end)
        -- تظليل عشان النص يبان
        local shade = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2}, card)
        corner(shade, 12)
        new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 36),
            Text = m.name, TextColor3 = C.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 13, TextWrapped = true, ZIndex = 3}, card)
        new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 22),
            Text = m.tag, TextColor3 = C.good, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextWrapped = true, ZIndex = 3}, card)
        cards[i] = {card = card, st = st}
        card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            picked = m
            for j, cd in ipairs(cards) do
                local on = (j == i)
                cd.card.BackgroundColor3 = on and C.cardHi or C.card
                cd.card.Size = on and UDim2.new(0.29, 0, 0, 124) or UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 118)
                cd.st.Color = on and C.accent2 or C.line
                cd.st.Transparency = on and 0 or 0.4
            end
        end)
    end

    local ok = bigButton(p, "OK", UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 1, -66), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 46))
    ok.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not picked then return end
        current = picked
        running = false      -- يبدأ مطفي، تشغله من الزر
        p:Destroy()
        showToggle()
    end)
end

-- ============ المفتاح ============
local function showKey()
    local p = makePanel(540, 230)
    new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52),
        Text = "أدخل المفتاح  |  ASTA", TextColor3 = C.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 20}, p)
    new("Frame", {Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0, 52), Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 2),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.line, BorderSizePixel = 0}, p)

    local box = new("TextBox", {
        Position = UDim2.new(0.08, 0, 0, 68), Size = UDim2.new(0.84, 0, 0, 46),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.card, TextColor3 = C.text, PlaceholderText = "اكتب المفتاح هنا",
        PlaceholderColor3 = C.sub, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 18,
    }, p)
    corner(box, 14); stroke(box, C.accent, 1.5, 0.3)

    local msg = new("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0.08, 0, 0, 118),
        Size = UDim2.new(0.84, 0, 0, 22), Text = "", TextColor3 = C.bad,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14}, p)

    local btn = bigButton(p, "تحقق", UDim2.new(0.08, 0, 1, -66), UDim2.new(0.84, 0, 0, 46))

    local busy = false
    local function submit()
        if busy then return end
        local v = box.Text
        if v == "" then
            msg.TextColor3 = C.bad; msg.Text = "اكتب المفتاح أول"
            return
        end
        if v == KEY then
            busy = true
            msg.TextColor3 = C.good; msg.Text = "تم التفعيل"
            task.wait(0.4)
            p:Destroy()
            showSelect()
        else
            msg.TextColor3 = C.bad; msg.Text = "خطأ: المفتاح غلط"
            box.Text = ""
            local o = p.Position
            for i = 1, 4 do
                p.Position = o + UDim2.new(0, (i % 2 == 0) and 8 or -8, 0, 0)
                task.wait(0.04)
            end
            p.Position = o
        end
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(submit)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then submit() end end)
end

showKey()
